description: Import a local file into the editor (absolute path, ~ allowed). Default as=scene: video/image/GIF/PDF becomes a new scene (returns createdSceneId). as=background / watermark-logo / cursor: an image is uploaded to the matching library and applied to the current scene. Audio files (mp3/wav/m4a/aac/ogg/flac) always go to the music library (returns createdLibraryId for audio.addMusic).

clearPoints.description: as=camera on a static scene with zoom points: pass true to remove them (the camera video rewrites scene duration)

sceneId.description: Required when as is background/watermark-logo/cursor/camera (read it from poindeo_get_project)

name: poindeo_import_media
